about: Prompt cases for the pre-install review of a Cockpit self-update (apps/api/src/update-review-prompt.ts).
Each case is a small diff with the focus areas the runner would report, the verdict a correct reviewer must give,
and an example of a correct answer in the required format. The unit tests (test/update-review.test.ts) only check
the deterministic parts: prompt assembly, answer parsing and the resulting policy. No model is called.
Later evaluation with a real model: build the prompt per case with buildUpdateReviewPrompt(caseToDiff(case)),
send it to the safety role, parse the answer with parseUpdateReviewAnswer, and compare the verdict (and, for
harmful cases, the guarantee of at least one finding) with `expected` / `guarantee`. Benign cases must come back
approve: a reviewer that flags them costs the owner an approval for nothing.
